bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As on 30 September 2021', headed 'NRB Global Bank Limited' -- the LAST filing under the pre-conversion legal name found in this dataset's research; the conversion to 'Global Islami Bank' therefore fell between this filing and FY2021 year-end (consistent with the FY2021 annual report's own account that the conversion happened 'during 2021'). Terminology is transitional throughout (dual labels like 'Loans and advances/Investments', 'Savings bank deposits/Mudaraba savings deposits'). Paid-up capital rose from 4,908.75m (Jun-2021) to 5,154.19m (Sep-2021) -- a capital increase occurred within this quarter. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparative column is 31 December 2020. Income-statement figures are DISCRETE for the quarter (Jul 1 - Sep 30, 2021), matching this filing's own header 'For the period from 01 July 2021 to 30 September 2021' with no cumulative column. 'Interest income/profit on investment' value was not legible in the source; derived as Net interest income + Interest/profit paid on deposits and borrowings (1,170,710,912 + 1,973,328,275 = 3,144,039,187), cross-validated exactly against this same discrete quarter as independently repeated in the comparative column of the September-2022 filing (which matches down to Total Operating Income, Total Operating Expenses, and Total Provision exactly). DISCREPANCY ON TAX/PAT: this filing's own P&L shows only a single 'Current tax' line of 267,853,374 with the Net Profit/(Loss) after taxation row itself illegible in the OCR (garbled beyond recovery); PAT is therefore calculated here as PBT (649,136,885, directly legible and matching the September-2022 filing's comparative exactly) minus this filing's own tax figure (267,853,374) = 381,283,511. However, the September-2022 filing's comparative column for this same quarter shows a different tax breakdown (Deferred tax 267,853,374 + Current tax -102,393,251 = Total tax 165,460,123) implying PAT of 483,676,762 instead -- a genuine, unresolved 102.4m-Taka discrepancy between how this quarter's tax was originally filed versus how it was later re-presented as a comparative (possibly an additional current-tax credit recognised only in the later filing). Per project policy the contemporaneous original filing's own components are used (PAT = 381.28m, itself a calculated_from_pl_components figure since the PAT line itself was illegible), and the alternative later figure (483.68m) is recorded here as an unresolved divergence, not used. EPS is similarly uncertain (OCR captured '0.94' and '0.49' near the EPS row but they could not be confidently tied to Q3-2021 vs its Q3-2020 comparator, and neither divides cleanly into either PAT candidate against known share counts); it is omitted rather than guessed.
